summary: Arrive AI Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Pre-Paid Purchase No. 5 agreement with Streeterville Capital, LLC, a financing arrangement under an existing securities purchase agreement. The company received $100,000 for a promissory note with $108,000 principal, including an $8,000 original issue discount, bearing 8% interest. The note permits conversion into common stock at a discount to VWAP, with the floor price reduced from $0.25 to $0.10 per share. This is a routine debt financing transaction, not a special situation.
